overview: A reviewed end-to-end design covering integration patterns, security boundary, ownership and failure management. The scope is built around workload inventories, dependency maps and cloud account permissions, producing landing-zone design, migration wave plan and cutover evidence. A customer-named cloud platform owner approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is application dependency and rollback verification.
